envelope.description: Emit idempotent usage and retained pause accounting

body.title: Emit idempotent usage and retained pause accounting
body.summary: Wire attempt usage observer and consumed active-time/attempt accounting into coordinator transitions through existing sc6 recordAttemptUsage. Preserve actual/estimated/unavailable provenance and pending writer state.
acceptanceChecks: Usage observations retain stable observation/attempt/provider/model IDs, existing five nullable counters, quality/granularity and native references.
Allowance/reserves/tool counts never become measured usage; unsupported native observation is unavailable and accepted replay emits no new charge.
Consumed active time/attempts survive yields, retries, cancellation and transport detach; pending/unavailable accounting state is visible for s4 outbox recovery.
No new usage warehouse, artifact JSON collection or storage backend; deterministic observer/clock/replay tests pass.

tests.name: Idempotent usage observations and retained active allowance
